lexicographic_objective: maximize the lower of Critical recall and Serious recall
anti_collapse_note: macro-F1 is the second criterion after minimizing unsafe high-risk under-triage; Critical precision is the final tie-breaker to discourage predicting Critical broadly
legacy_test_policy: do not use for checkpoint selection; one post-selection regression evaluation only
challenge_policy: blank human intake remains untouched; no challenge labels exist
calibration_policy: no calibration fitting on selected validation data; report calibration as unavailable/insufficient unless an independent calibration set exists
